title: The Domain of the Soul
coreMove: Stillness reaches the soul when you check the hidden current below your calm: conscience, desire, old wounds, and the status hunger that can make achievement feel restless.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who equate a low voice with real calm
exampleSpecs.stakes: unseen resentment could leak into the next handoff
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Costa hears the ocean-current reframe at the dishwashing station.

exampleSpecs.audience: new guides learning how calm can mislead
exampleSpecs.stakes: a trainee may treat a quiet group as a safe group
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Gregoire uses learner confusion at a trailhead signboard to teach surface versus current.

exampleSpecs.stakes: status could make overwork look like virtue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Dawson is shown before and after one variable changes: public praise is removed.

exampleSpecs.audience: organizers who see praise before strain
exampleSpecs.stakes: visible success could hide burnout and unfair load
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sylvia reviews the bulletin board and finds one attendance-sheet pattern that changes her read.

exampleSpecs.audience: makers tempted to let ambition bend the truth
exampleSpecs.stakes: a small lie could turn achievement into unrest
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Zane thinks through the hidden current at the darkroom sink without outside dialogue.

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders choosing where scarce attention goes
exampleSpecs.stakes: visible output could crowd out quiet safety work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Dante allocates scarce attention before any action happens at the lab safety bench.
